bead.title: Wire shared commit-transition decline scenario into postgres suites
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The shared commit-transition scenario from governing artifact/dependency pqueue-c42136f3 is not invoked by the postgres log-replay or postgres-relational suites, so the decline-path contract is only covered by bespoke tests instead of the common conformance harness.

ROOT CAUSE
crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/conformance.rs:56 enumerates postgres log-replay conformance scenarios without the shared commit-transition decline scenario. crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/relational_conformance.rs:63 enumerates postgres-relational scenarios without the shared commit-transition decline scenario. crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs:105 contains bespoke decline coverage that is not yet redundant with a shared harness invocation.

PROPOSED FIX
Invoke the pqueue-c42136f3 shared commit-transition scenario for PostgresBackend and PostgresRelationalBackend, preserving the existing PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL env gate, fresh schema isolation, loud skip behavior, and non-tokio executor pattern used by the postgres conformance files. The scenario must exercise the decline path for both postgres flavors.

NON-SCOPE
Do not implement real CommitTransitionPort behavior for postgres/objectlog; that is a separate epic. Do not convert postgres from decline path to positive path. Do not remove pqueue-0ef6807b bespoke decline tests until the shared harness decline path is wired and a cleanup bead proves redundancy. Preserve all existing env-gated live-DB behavior.

DEPENDENCIES
Requires pqueue-c42136f3. Parent: pqueue-54039317.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestPostgresLogCommitTransitionDecline: with PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL set, `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test conformance --all-features commit_transition` runs the shared decline scenario against PostgresBackend and passes.
2. TestPostgresRelationalCommitTransitionDecline: with PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL set, `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test relational_conformance --all-features commit_transition` runs the shared decline scenario against PostgresRelationalBackend and passes.
3. TestPostgresDeclineSkipGate: without PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL, the postgres shared decline invocations print loud skips and return green, matching the existing suite policy.
4. TestCargoWorkspaceGate: `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features` passes.
5. TestGoWorkspaceGate: `go test ./...` passes or is documented as not applicable because the repository has no Go packages.
6. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
7. TestRustStyleGate: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
